concept.title: Pagination and rate limits
concept.shortdesc: List endpoints return results in pages, and each API key can make a limited number of requests per minute.

section.title: Pagination
section.p: List endpoints accept a limit (1–100, default 25) and return a next_cursor. To get the next page, pass it back as cursor. When next_cursor is null, you've reached the end.
Cursors are stable: records added while you page through a list don't cause duplicates or gaps.

section.title: Rate limits
section.p: Each key can make requests per minute. Every response includes these headers:

strow.stentry: Requests left in the current window
Unix time when the window resets

section.p: If you exceed the limit, you get a 429 response with a Retry-After header. Wait that many seconds before retrying, and use exponential backoff for repeated failures.
